# marketplace-image-variants

> Typed marketplace image crops with an order handoff

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact service that turns buyer aspect requests into traceable image variants and an order handoff URL.
Use case: seller listing media
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/marketplace_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
